derivative_policy.json_omits: local paths, UUIDs, catalog/source/asset identifiers, process identifiers, unrelated desktop data, and raw logs
derivative_policy.json_retains: generated-only numeric measurements, app identity values, code digests, filtered raw telemetry arrays, and capture digests
derivative_policy.published_images: eight Qt app-window captures copied byte-for-byte from the run; they contain only generated fixture content and app UI, and may visibly show synthetic fixture identifiers and the isolated temporary fixture root
derivative_policy.source: attempt 4 native acceptance JSON, retained stage receipts, KWin receipt, and generated app-only captures

interpretation_limits: Evidence covers only a generated 64-image workload and the stated single 1920×1200 original on the recorded Nobara KDE Wayland host.
It is not a release qualification, broad accessibility audit, package-install test, or certification for plain Fedora or another platform.
SDD §19.2 candidate performance budgets remain unadopted; measured values are descriptive observations only.
The 1.0 device-pixel ratio run does not establish high-DPI behavior.
record_type: filtered public derivative of native acceptance evidence

thumbnail_loading.heartbeat_gap_measurements_ms_scope: cold-loading phase only; raw gaps are computed between heartbeat ticks through cold-phase completion

process_tree_rss_sampling.limitations: process-tree RSS may double-count shared pages and miss short child peaks; includes Python and Qt workers; excludes compositor, system, and GPU memory
process_tree_rss_sampling.sampling: sampled every 10 nominal 5 ms timer ticks
process_tree_rss_sampling.scope: whole probe while the timer remained active through viewer and KWin stages; the completed stage archive retains the shared sample list through timer shutdown

thumbnail_loading.scope: completion from window show, including queueing; not decoder CPU time
